mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 63 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing crescent moon above.

Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and check out their selection.
